ko.title: AI 배포 주장 위험·독립 검토
ko.summary: 홀드아웃 R3를 추가했습니다. “개청 기념 자료가 새만금 피지컬AI·데이터센터의 건설·가동 완료를 입증한다”는 주장입니다. 원문은 기본계획 변경 중이며 현대차 투자 맥락에서 미래산업 거점으로 도약한다고만 하고, 현대차 원문도 데이터센터·로봇·수소 시설을 계획으로 씁니다. 위험은 완료 환각, 단계 과장, 기관 보증 확대, 시간선 압축입니다.
ko.currentQuestion: 독립 검토자가 기존 비전의 공식 재확인과 새 건설·가동 사실을 구분할 수 있는가?

zh.title: 可访问的不确定性动态界面

zh.currentQuestion: 强制颜色、读屏和实体键盘同时使用时，六态是否仍可被真实用户区分？

en.title: Accessible Dynamic Interfaces for Uncertainty
en.summary: Added a Windows high-contrast/forced-colours fallback to the six-state prototype. Canvas, CanvasText, and system borders replace custom colours while state text and non-colour shapes remain. Automated regression rises from seven to eight passing checks; existing light-mode contrast remains 4.69–6.52.
en.currentQuestion: When forced colours, screen reading, and a physical keyboard combine, can real users still distinguish all six states?
en.todayMaterial: Prototype v3 and scripts/test-uncertainty-states.mjs v2: forced-colours check added; eight automated checks pass.
en.next: Next output: real-user tasks in Windows high contrast and macOS VoiceOver, with confusion matrices.
en.unfinished: Source-level regression is not real assistive-technology or comprehension acceptance.

en.title: Motion Grammar for Uncertainty
en.summary: Create non-misleading motion and color language for confidence, data gaps, conflicting evidence, and revised judgments.
en.next: Next output: motion specification for six uncertainty states.

ko.title: 접근 가능한 불확실성 동적 인터페이스
ko.summary: 6상태 원형에 Windows 고대비/강제 색상 대체를 추가했습니다. Canvas·CanvasText·시스템 테두리가 사용자 지정 색을 대체해도 상태 텍스트와 비색상 도형은 유지됩니다. 자동 회귀는 7개에서 8개 통과로 늘었고 기존 밝은 모드 대비 4.69~6.52도 유지됩니다.
ko.currentQuestion: 강제 색상·스크린리더·물리 키보드를 함께 사용할 때 실제 사용자가 6상태를 구분하는가?
ko.todayMaterial: 원형 v3와 scripts/test-uncertainty-states.mjs v2: forced-colors 검사 추가, 자동 검사 8개 통과.
ko.next: 다음 산출물: Windows 고대비와 macOS VoiceOver 실제 사용자 과제 및 혼동행렬.
ko.unfinished: 소스 수준 회귀는 실제 보조기술·이해도 인수가 아닙니다.

zh.title: 多语公共写作的证据强度词包
zh.summary: 把数字六联写成可运行结构校验：对2,373条媒体项、203条法定公告和17家计划受检企业分别生成中英韩记录，共9条；主体、对象、阶段、事件日、来源、否定边界六字段全部通过。测试同时明确结构完整不等于母语等值或读者理解。

en.title: Evidence-Strength Phrasebook for Multilingual Public Writing
en.summary: Turned the six-link number rule into an executable structural check. Chinese, English, and Korean records cover 2,373 media items, 203 statutory notices, and 17 firms scheduled for inspection: nine records total, all with actor, object, stage, event date, source, and negative boundary. The test states that structural completeness is not native equivalence or reader comprehension.
en.currentQuestion: Which field will be lost when structurally complete sentences are compressed for mobile and back-translated by native reviewers?
en.todayMaterial: scripts/test-publication-six-link.mjs v1: three metrics by three languages, nine records, six fields, zero missing.
en.next: Next output: three native reviewers independently compress and back-translate, logging field loss and comprehension differences.
en.unfinished: The structural test passes, but native sign-off and reader-comprehension data are absent.

ko.next: 다음 산출물: 세 원어민의 독립 압축·역번역과 필드 손실·이해 편차 기록.

ko.next: 다음 산출물: 독자 질문 분류와 환류 규칙.

zh.title: 联盟承诺量表的三案例校准包
zh.summary: 在每个五因子允许相对首评分±1且限制0—2分的情景枚举中，北约、韩中新万金MOU和机构工作坊分别有48、48、72个变体，共165,888组三案例。严格保持“9>5>2”相对顺序的情景占50.6%；北约高于MOU为79.2%，MOU高于工作坊为69.5%。这不是概率，但证明总分范围重叠、排序对评分分歧敏感。
zh.currentQuestion: 第二盲评者在哪些因子上产生的真实分歧会破坏排序？
zh.todayMaterial: scripts/test-commitment-scale-sensitivity.mjs v1：±1因子情景、165,888组枚举、总分范围与排序保持率。
zh.next: 下一成果：取得第二评分后，用真实因子差异替换均匀情景，不平均掉分歧。
zh.unfinished: 仍无第二独立评分或一年后行为数据；50.6%是情景占比，不是统计概率。

zh.next: 下一成果：确定承诺强度的五项评分规则。

en.title: Three-Case Calibration Pack for the Alliance Commitment Scale
en.summary: Enumerated bounded ±1 changes to each 0–2 factor around the first rating: 48 NATO, 48 Saemangeum MoU, and 72 workshop variants, producing 165,888 three-case combinations. The strict 9>5>2 order holds in 50.6% of scenarios; NATO exceeds the MoU in 79.2%, and the MoU exceeds the workshop in 69.5%. These are scenario shares, not probabilities, but they show overlapping total ranges and ranking sensitivity.
en.currentQuestion: Which real factor disagreements from a second blind rater will break the ordering?
en.todayMaterial: scripts/test-commitment-scale-sensitivity.mjs v1: bounded factor scenarios, 165,888 combinations, total ranges, and ordering shares.
en.next: Next output: replace uniform scenarios with observed factor differences after a second rating; do not average away disagreement.
en.unfinished: No independent second rating or one-year behavior data exists; 50.6% is not a statistical probability.

en.title: Alliance-Commitment Durability Stress Test
en.summary: Use costs, exit conditions, domestic constraints, and implementation records to judge whether cooperation is credible and durable.
en.next: Next output: five scoring rules for commitment strength.

ko.title: 동맹 약속 척도 3사례 보정 패킷

ko.todayMaterial: scripts/test-commitment-scale-sensitivity.mjs v1: ±1 요인 시나리오, 165,888개 조합, 총점 범위, 순서 유지율.
ko.next: 다음 산출물: 두 번째 평가 후 균등 시나리오를 관찰된 요인 차이로 바꾸고 이견을 평균내지 않습니다.
ko.unfinished: 독립 두 번째 평가와 1년 행동 자료가 없으며 50.6%는 통계 확률이 아닙니다.

zh.title: 公共主张来源与撤回链

en.title: Source and Withdrawal Chain for Public Claims
en.summary: The second real cross-day audit first ran against the 12-source 11 September baseline: 12/12 reachable, seven HTML hash changes, and five stable resources unchanged. Domain rereads found one substantive register change—two institutional-governance releases—while notices remained 203 and NATO text still supported prior coding; four GitHub pages remained dynamic noise. The refresh added three primary sources and retired two old attachments superseded by today's evidence, forming a 13-source public baseline. No fact was auto-withdrawn.
en.currentQuestion: Can repeated dynamic-HTML changes form a noise-frequency baseline while genuine new register entries receive priority review?
en.todayMaterial: Cross-day difference audit v2: seven changed/five unchanged across the old 12, one substantive register change and six without factual effect; three sources added, two retired, refreshed to 13.
en.next: Next output: compare the 13-source baseline on 13 September, count dynamic-page change frequency, and prioritize stable attachments and newest register identifiers.
en.unfinished: No real withdrawal has been triggered; two days of dynamic noise cannot justify automatic review downgrades.
